postal_system.assignment_rule: The Universal Postal Union September 2025 Universal DataBase list includes Bolivia among countries and territories which do not require postal codes. Its Bolivia addressing sheet, edition 2/2026, shows home, P.O. Box and rural delivery without a postcode line. The current Agencia Boliviana de Correos portal exposes shipment tracking identifiers such as PE123456789, P.O. Box services and office labels; none is a postcode assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No national postcode assignments exist to anchor postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Department, province, municipality, locality, office, route, service-area, address, building, parcel, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, model, AGID cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed. The indexed CodigoPostal Polygon FeatureServer is in Colombia and must not be relabelled as Bolivia.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, P.O. Box, street and house number, sub-locality, locality and Bolivia as separate fields. Rural descriptive directions remain descriptive address context. Do not insert a fabricated postcode into a domestic address; a generic optional postcode field in an M0 inventory is not postal authority.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store P.O. Box, street delivery, rural delivery, shipment tracking, offices, routes and services independently. Casilla Postal 3515 and PE123456789 are identifiers for a box and a tracked shipment, not postal-area keys.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Preserve BO, department, province, municipality and locality identity separately. Do not merge Bolivia with a neighbouring country, replace postal authority with an administrative code or borrow foreign postcode geometry.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic-address identity and explicit reviewed relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. A locality label, route, office, parcel, coordinate or synthetic BO code is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may validate an address or service location only under source-specific rights. They must return no-postcode or independently typed context for BO, never manufacture a code or postal surface, and preserve source, version, request digest, time, confidence and derived status.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. BO administrative, route, address or building relations may be indexed only from separately authorized sources and never become Agencia Boliviana de Correos codes or canonical postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The reviewed Agencia Boliviana de Correos portal asserts 2026 copyright, links Terminos y Condiciones only to # and publishes no open postal dataset licence. UPU publications are reference evidence only. The unrelated ArcGIS item has empty licence and access-information fields. Public access does not establish AGID processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights.
postal_system.privacy_rule: The portal body contains office addresses and contact details, which remain outside Git. Recipient, customer, P.O. Box holder, delivery observation, exact address, coordinate, building, parcel, resident, owner, occupant, query log and land-right information require independent authority, purpose, minimisation, retention and publication review.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-postcode finding is time-dependent. Store retrieval time, UPU edition, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check after the pending-country sweep or when Agencia Boliviana de Correos or UPU announces a postcode system. Never rewrite historical evidence as timeless.

stages.definition: Bolivia generic address-format inventory and source links only.
Digest-bound Agencia Boliviana de Correos and UPU no-postcode evidence plus rights, identity, privacy, tracking/P.O.-Box typing and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative Agencia Boliviana de Correos or competent public release establishing a Bolivia postcode system and a complete finite denominator of every code assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The UPU September 2025 no-postcode list and February 2026 Bolivia addressing sheet currently establish that a postcode search key and denominator do not exist; absence is represented as none and does not itself satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon visualization milestone. Tracking identifiers, P.O. Box numbers, department or office codes and foreign postcodes never count. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Departments, provinces, municipalities, localities, offices, routes, service areas, addresses, buildings, parcels, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, models, AGID cells and synthetic BO planning codes are prohibited proxies. P.O. Box, route, organization, Point and other non-area objects must expose their type and reason without a fabricated surface and remain M2-unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real BO API/app, which handles no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, supports clear/re-search, and displays the selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: BO metadata and no-postcode policy only; no real BO Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual BO loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a Bolivia postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, route, address, parcel or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified and never inherits postal authority.
